description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the I18NLanguageAPI, testing various API methods such as getAll, update, getOne, and delete within the OrangeHRM admin plugin's API v2. It defines test cases using data providers and mocks for dependencies.

classes.name: I18NLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for the I18NLanguageAPI class, testing its CRUD functionality and integration with the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all language entries via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll API test.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a language entry through the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update API test.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create method, which is not implemented, expecting an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for creation, expected to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single language entry by ID.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for getOne API method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of a language entry.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for delete API method.
